About me

I'm Punitham Senthilkumar. I fell in love with reading at four and started writing my own little stories at eight. At ten, I learned about the 17 Sustainable Development Goals and wanted to do something about them.

At twelve I published A Girl with 17 Dreams, which explains the goals as stories that children can follow. It is now in English and Tamil.

My story, one age at a time

About 18th Dream Organisation

There are 17 global goals. The 18th dream is that young people don't just read about them, they act on them.

We run book readings, awareness sessions, sustainability initiatives and leadership programmes with schools, colleges, educators, foundations and industry leaders. Since we started, we have reached more than 18,000 people.

Think global. Act local.

A Girl with 17 Dreams

17 stories on the Sustainable Development Goals, written by Punitham Senthilkumar when she was 12. Each story turns one goal into something a child can picture and care about.

English edition: 25 September 2025. Tamil edition, Oru Sirumiyin 17 Kanavugal: 16 November 2025. Endorsed by Dr. Mylswamy Annadurai, former ISRO Director.
